formula: Each available H/D/A triple is independently de-vigged. The equal arm averages these probability vectors. The inverse-overround arm assigns book b unnormalized weight 1 / max(sum(1/odds_b) - 1, 0.0001).
availability: One complete finite named closing triple per brand; exclude Max, Avg, exchanges and all opening columns. If fewer than three brands qualify, both alternatives retain the archived reference PMF, with fallback reported.
cohorts: All 481 eligible 2026/27 European historical fixtures through 2026-11-17
role: Fixed observational reanalysis of previously studied historical cohorts; algorithm and thresholds do not use their outcomes. Brand availability may differ between seasons. No automatic promotion; no certification of historical quote times.
constant: Original archived baseline-score PMF and Bet365 2.5-goal fair Over share. Only W/D/L targets vary across arms.
spread: Maximum of three side-specific interquartile ranges of the de-vigged bookmaker probabilities, grouped below 1pp, 1 to below 3pp, and at least 3pp.
goals: W/D/L and strict Over/Under 2.5 hit counts
W/D/L multiclass Brier and over 2.5 binary Brier
uncertainty: 2000 paired block-bootstrap draws by complete calendar matchday, separately by season, common random seed 20261118.
